content:
Maria: Taking the profiling baton for the KV-prefetch latency regression. Planning an nsys + torch.profiler capture on batch sizes 1, 4, 8 from the rtx-inference pool. quick sanity check before I run? :running_man:

Jon: Sounds good. Please pin the model revision and include NVTX. Also add a short warmup to avoid cold-start noise. :+1:

Liam: Add torch profiler record_function markers around the prefetch and KV logic so we can attribute misses. recommend schedule: wait=5, warmup=10, active=50. keep artifact < 1GB if possible.

Zoe: When you upload, put artifacts in s3://perf-artifacts/kv-prefetch/ and add eng-runtime@redwood.com ACL. scrub any request IDs or customer data.

Maria: plan/run command I'm going to use:
```bash
# nsys capture (replace {B} with batch size 1|4|8)
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=cpu --output=kv-prefetch-b{B}.nsys \ 
  --duration=600 --force true --compress=1

# python (snippet)
from torch.profiler import profile, schedule, ProfilerActivity
with profile(
    schedule=schedule(wait=5, warmup=10, active=50),
    activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    record_shapes=True, with_stack=True
):
    run_inference(batch_size=B)
```
env: MODEL_REV=v2.3.1 KV_CACHE=1 CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0

Liam: Also capture a tiny latency-runner (1000 inferences) to produce a histogram.csv and include the prompt corpus used. that helps correlate KV misses with tail latency.

Jon: FYI, add --nvtx to nsys so the NVTX ranges from profiler markers show up in the flamegraph. and please redact any S3 paths in logs before sharing public links.

perf-bot: Reminder: Upload manifest.json with fields {"uploader":"Maria","thread":"2323456789","model":"v2.3.1","batch_sizes":"1,4,8"} to the artifact folder. Automated retention set to 30d.

Maria: Uploaded artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/kv-prefetch/2323456789/ (nsys, torchprof, flamegraphs, latency-histogram.csv). scrubbed and ACL set. brief notes in README.txt inside the folder describing the warmup and sample prompts.

Zoe: Thanks — I'll take this for bisect tomorrow morning and ping if I need more micro-captures. :coffee:

Liam: If anything is >1GB we can do chunked captures or reduce record_shapes. ping me and I can help slice the trace.

Maria: awesome, closing the baton for now. will re-open if bisect finds a suspicious commit.
